about: Guided consultation evals: a scripted clinician answers the intake questions; the run checks the questioning automatically and writes the report for the clinician to grade. Answers not scripted get 'I don't know'. All cases are invented.

cases.case: 9-year-old boy, Class 4, English-medium school. About 10 months of holding saliva then spitting, rewinding reels, making parents repeat words, avoiding black objects ('black omen'), hair picking, fear of darkness and heavy YouTube/Roblox use; gradual onset. No prior therapy, no medications, no medical issues. Lives with both parents and an older sibling who go along with the rituals. Risk asked and absent. Parents want a full therapy plan with parent coaching.
I have a client who has been feeling low and wants guidance.

answers.age_gender: 16, male. It started 6 months ago, gradually, before board exams. Risk asked and absent.
